name: The Campaigner
work_style: Energetic, idea-driven, and people-inspiring. Excel at the creative and conceptual phase of work. Generate enthusiasm and connection. Need variety and autonomy to stay engaged. Struggle with routine and bureaucracy.
decision_making: Intuitive and enthusiastic. Make decisions based on gut and values, but can be swayed by social input. Benefit from structured decision frameworks.
leadership_style: Lead through energy, vision, and genuine enthusiasm for people. Excel at culture-building. Need operational partners for execution discipline.
